items.headline: Best-Positioned Stocks as EV and Self-Driving Tech Accelerate
items.snippet: ALB projects 10-20% lithium demand CAGR 2025-2030; Greenbushes CGP3 full production expected Q1 2027; Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Tight lithium market on EV and stationary storage demand, supply lagging. Maintained 2026 outlook, expecting high end of scenario ranges. $100M run-rate savings YTD. Net income $480M, diluted EPS $3.52. Lithium demand up 45% through May.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares down 29.1% in six months; lithium price pullback on softer China EV demand, elevated inventory and mine restarts, while energy storage demand stays resilient.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: ALB reached tentative wage agreement with Chilean union ahead of a strike; ratification vote pending.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: Chinese EV sales fell 13% in H1 2026 yet global lithium consumption jumped 45% through May; stationary storage driving the gap. US Commerce imposed one-year block on black mass exports Aug 6.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from energy storage pushes prices higher. China spot lithium prices surged 22% this year. Albemarle (ALB) noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, significantly outstripping supply.
